comment: A bit of a hard grader but that's kinda expected for a first year teacher. Vwery approachable and wants to teach and wants his students to learn. might I add he is SUPER easy on the eyes.

Awesome professor!I loved his classes that were an amazing mixture of lectures, discussions and mere conversation. He really knows his stuff and uses examples form current events. We had to write 5 reading responses and had midterm and final. There are also lot of chances to get some participation points!

Finn's the man! He's a new professor who really tries hard to make class entertaining and informative. His class structure made that hour & 15 mins fly by because its more conversational than a straight up lecture. He's a tough grader but he's fair, flexible, and wants his students to do well. He's also super chill and uses phrases like "word up."
